review.brief:
Review the DIFF of commits d1919d5~1..d90511a (do NOT read the whole module). NOTE: ft/CH1-telemetry-dedupe-daily-snapshots was merged into main via PR #12 and deleted locally; you are on main. This change is EXACTLY the two commits d1919d5 (feat) and d90511a (test) - use `git diff d1919d5~1..d90511a`. Do NOT review bebf317 (skills sync) or 6d74eff (RM7 artifacts + app.css): both are on main but belong to OTHER work and are out of scope. Validate, in priority order:
(1) DB-design fidelity (BLOCKER on mismatch): the migration 20260805000001 must match design.md's Schema DDL exactly - column names captured_date DATE / updated_at TIMESTAMPTZ, constraint name vehicle_snapshots_account_tesla_date_unique, and the Up statement ORDER (add col -> backfill -> dedupe delete -> UNIQUE -> SET NOT NULL -> add updated_at). The user confirmed this design at a blocking gate (decision D6); any deviation is a blocker finding.
(2) Design decisions D1-D5 are actually implemented, not just described: D1 ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE refreshes every typed column + raw_data + captured_at + updated_at=now() and never the 3 conflict-target columns; D2/D2a captured_date is Go-computed via dateOnly from Config.Location with the time.Local fallback, and is NOT a DB expression/generated column anywhere; D4 poll_attempts is untouched (grep the diff - zero hits outside pre-existing code); D5 updated_at is DB-owned (never an InsertVehicleSnapshotParams field) and is NOT mapped onto the domain Snapshot.
(3) Module boundaries (ai/architecture.md): internal/telemetry imports only the account + tesla public ports; no accountdb / tesla internals; pgtype appears nowhere in a public type or interface (dateFrom/pgtype.Date confined to service.go + mapping.go); no HTML. cmd/poller/main.go is thin wiring ONLY - zero business logic.
(4) Performance-Profile compliance: read-heavy. Confirm the two existing read queries' plans/shapes are unchanged, that idx_vehicle_snapshots_vehicle_time is retained (design.md Index Plan argues it is NOT redundant with the new UNIQUE index), and that captured_date/updated_at were appended to the END of all three SELECT lists so sqlc still shares ONE telemetrydb.VehicleSnapshot struct and rowToSnapshot stays a single shared mapper.
(5) Test coverage vs the Test Blast Radius section: EVERY Snapshot{} literal reaching st.insertSnapshot in the four DB integration test files sets CapturedDate; no literal relies on the time.Time zero value; the replaced append-only test genuinely asserts same-day-replace AND different-day-new-row. Pay special attention to any test inserting 2+ snapshots for ONE vehicle - if the fixtures are same-day they now silently collapse to one row via the upsert, which can gut what the test claims to cover (the leader already fixed exactly this in TestReadStore_LatestSnapshotsByAccount_MultiVehicleLatestWins, decision D10 - check for any remaining instance).
(6) Docs: internal/telemetry/AGENTS.md Data ownership no longer claims vehicle_snapshots is append-only, still correctly claims poll_attempts IS, and cites the superseding change. Confirm README.md genuinely needs no change (no module added/removed, no new runnable).
(7) Anti-gaming: no task title, acceptance criterion, or assertion was weakened/deleted to make work look complete; tasks.md checkboxes match reality.
NEVER run make test / make check / make migrate-up / make db-reset, and never run go test with DATABASE_URL set - .env points at the LIVE database and this migration deletes rows. The leader ran the full gate `make check` on 2026-08-07 (see events): build+vet+ui-guard green, `env -u DATABASE_URL go test ./...` all packages ok, internal/telemetry 85 tests PASS with ZERO skips against a disposable testcontainer (make test unsets DATABASE_URL by design), including TestStore_SnapshotUpsert_SameDayReplaces. The live DB was never touched. Do not re-run it. Never call the live Tesla API. Escalate on doubt: return changes-requested rather than approving anything you are unsure of.

rounds.notes: Reviewed diff d1919d5~1..d90511a exactly (feat+test commits). (1) Migration 20260805000001 matches design.md DDL verbatim: column names, constraint name vehicle_snapshots_account_tesla_date_unique, and Up order (add col -> backfill America/Bogota -> dedupe DELETE -> UNIQUE -> SET NOT NULL -> add updated_at). (2) D1 upsert ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE refreshes every typed column + raw_data + captured_at + updated_at=now(), never touches account_id/tesla_id/captured_date; D2/D2a captured_date computed via dateOnly(capturedAt.In(loc)) in Go, Config.Location with time.Local fallback, not a DB expression; D4 poll_attempts has zero touches outside pre-existing/AGENTS.md prose; D5 updated_at is DB-owned (DEFAULT now() / ON CONFLICT SET now()), never in InsertVehicleSnapshotParams call site, never mapped in rowToSnapshot. (3) internal/telemetry imports only account + tesla public packages + telemetrydb; pgtype confined to service.go/mapping.go (telemetry.go only mentions pgtype in a doc comment); cmd/poller/main.go diff is pure wiring (moved time.LoadLocation earlier, added Location field), zero business logic. (4) Both read queries (LatestSnapshotsByAccount, SnapshotsByVehicleSince) unchanged in predicate/ORDER BY, only append captured_date/updated_at to SELECT lists at the end, preserving the shared telemetrydb.VehicleSnapshot struct; idx_vehicle_snapshots_vehicle_time retained per design.md index plan. (5) All Snapshot{} literals across db_integration_test.go, db_read_integration_test.go, db_sourcea_integration_test.go, db_tpms_integration_test.go set CapturedDate explicitly via dateOnly(...); TestStore_SnapshotUpsert_SameDayReplaces and TestStore_SnapshotInsert_DifferentDayCreatesNewRow both present and correct; TestReadStore_LatestSnapshotsByAccount_MultiVehicleLatestWins already fixed (D10) with 26h/1h offsets guaranteeing different calendar days. (6) internal/telemetry/AGENTS.md Data ownership rewritten correctly: vehicle_snapshots no longer append-only, poll_attempts still explicitly append-only, cites telemetry-dedupe-daily-snapshots by name; no README.md exists for this module and root README.md/cmd/README.md correctly untouched (no module/runnable change). (7) tasks.md checkboxes match actual implementation; progress.json events corroborate the leader's make check claim (85 PASS/0 SKIP via testcontainer, build+vet green). No blockers, majors, or minors found.

decisions.decision: Conflict rule is REPLACE - latest capture of a calendar day wins (ON CONFLICT DO UPDATE)
decisions.why: A re-run normally corrects a bad/partial nightly capture, so freshest data should survive

decisions.decision: captured_date DATE column computed in Go from the poller's *time.Location; UNIQUE (account_id, tesla_id, captured_date)
decisions.why: A UNIQUE index cannot depend on the runtime POLLER_TIMEZONE env var; expression indexes on UTC or a hardcoded zone were rejected

decisions.decision: Backfill dedupe keeps the latest captured_at; the older row of each pair is deleted
decisions.why: Consistent with D1 so historical and future rows share one semantic. 2 rows deleted (verified live).

decisions.decision: Scope is vehicle_snapshots only; poll_attempts stays append-only
decisions.why: poll_attempts records every attempt including failures/retries - the availability signal a daily collapse would destroy

decisions.decision: Reverse the append-only invariant (supersedes RM1 design D1), document the supersession, and add updated_at
decisions.why: The original rationale for omitting updated_at (never overwritten) no longer holds once rows can be replaced

decisions.decision: Database design gate CONFIRMED - schema, rationale and index plan approved as specified in design.md
decisions.why: Blocking gate per CLAUDE.md Design-Gates: database. Backfill timezone literal verified immaterial (0/44 rows differ between UTC and America/Bogota).

decisions.decision: Leader-fixed TestReadStore_LatestSnapshotsByAccount_MultiVehicleLatestWins: vehicle A's two fixtures moved from -2h/-1h to -26h/-1h so they land on different calendar days
